title: Bottle Cleanup and Mountain Scene
tests: Separates an attached-photo edit from a new scene-generation request, completing both while retaining the reference product's identity.

faults.what: The white-background image alters the bottle rather than keeping it unchanged: the finish is noticeably shinier, the shoulder highlights are reshaped, and the base has a more pronounced horizontal seam and more regular ribbing than the source.

judge.summary: Both requested square compositions are supplied, and the sunrise lake scene works well, but the white-background edit visibly changes the bottle.

must_haves.item: Two separate square images are supplied, not a combined collage.
must_haves.why: Two individual square output images are shown.

must_haves.item: The first image retains the source bottle's silhouette, matte black finish and lid details against a plain white background.
must_haves.why: The general silhouette and loop-lid design are close, and the background is white, but the bottle has a shinier finish and altered base detailing.

must_haves.item: Neither the wooden table nor the original background remains in the first image.
must_haves.why: The original room and wooden tabletop are completely removed.

must_haves.item: The second image realistically shows the same bottle upright on a rock beside a mountain lake, with visible sunrise lighting.
must_haves.why: The recognizable black bottle stands upright on a textured rock beside a mountain lake, with warm low-angle light and convincing contact shadows.

must_haves.item: Neither image contains added text or logos.
must_haves.why: No text or logos are visible in either output.
